描述_EN: the central scene depicted is one of four women playing a game of dominoes, with all 32 tiles laid out in a specific formation. the cross in the centre of the embroidery is made up of inverted chinese characters: happiness (‘fu’), prosperity (‘lu’) and longevity (‘shou’). it is also unusual that cotton is used in place of the more commonly used material, silk. the inversion of the characters symbolises ‘the arrival of the three stars of happiness, prosperity and longevity’, as the chinese word for inversion is a homonym for the word for arrival (‘dao’). the patterns that appear on this textile are not often featured on other kinds of textiles. this cotton embroidery may provide some evidence of a folk design that had currency before imperial and aristocratic tastes overtook the visual culture of china. chinese cross-stitch embroideries were made by women at home in preparation for weddings.
描述_ZN: 描绘的中心场景是四个女人在玩多米诺骨牌游戏，所有的32张牌都以特定的队形摆放。 绣品中央的十字架是由倒置的汉字组成的：幸福（'福'）、繁荣（'禄'）和长寿（'寿'）。 用棉布代替更常用的材料丝绸，也是不寻常的。 这些字的倒置象征着 "幸福、繁荣和长寿三星的到来"，因为倒置的中文词与到来的中文词同音（"道"）。 这种纺织品上出现的图案在其他种类的纺织品上不常出现。 这种棉布刺绣可能提供了一些民间设计的证据，这种设计在帝国和贵族的口味笼罩中国的视觉文化之前就已经流行了。 中国的十字绣是妇女在家里为婚礼做的准备。
